find:
focusInView(target);
    for (const cb of arrivalCbs) cb(graceMs);
replace:
target.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    for (const cb of arrivalCbs) cb(graceMs);
why: Turning the browser's focus scroll off is half of the arrival's focus (issue #919); without `focusInView`'s own scroll, a primary out of its pane's view takes focus where the player cannot see it.
